name: harmonic_pattern_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional algorithmic orders (FII/DII TWAP execution, momentum algo tranches) decompose large directional positions into two structured legs, creating measurable AB=CD wave patterns at the 30-second to 10-minute scale. When NIFTY's CD leg completes at 1.0x or 1.272x the AB length — the Fibonacci extension point where the algo's second participation tranche exhausts — a sharp contra-move of 10-25 spot points occurs within the first 15-90 seconds as resting limit orders clustered at the Fibonacci level absorb the exhausted flow. The BC retracement (38-88% of AB) confirms genuine institutional wave structure rather than random noise, because market-maker hedging during the BC phase is the mechanism that 'loads the spring' for the CD extension. At 5-second resolution, the D-pivot confirmation (available 30 seconds after the actual turning point) allows entry at the very start of the reversal, capturing 50-70% of the initial snap-back before new directional flow resumes.

indicators.name: swing_pivot_high
indicators.formula: high[k] is a high pivot if high[k] > all high[k±j] for j in 1..min_bars_pivot
indicators.purpose: min_bars_pivot=6 (30 seconds) to distinguish genuine NIFTY intraday swings from 5-second microstructure noise. The original used 3 bars minimum on 1-min charts (3 minutes). We compress to 30 seconds because we're trading the D-point reversal — we need pivots to form quickly enough that A→D spans 5-30 minutes total, keeping the pattern relevant to our 15-120 second hold. Shorter (3 bars=15s) produces too many false pivots on NIFTY's noisy 5-second tape; longer (12 bars=60s) makes patterns too infrequent and staleness risk rises.

indicators.name: swing_pivot_low
indicators.formula: low[k] is a low pivot if low[k] < all low[k±j] for j in 1..min_bars_pivot
indicators.purpose: Same 30-second confirmation window as swing_pivot_high. Causal detection: pivot at bar k is confirmed at bar k+min_bars_pivot, introducing a 30-second lag. This lag is acceptable because the thesis is to catch the reversal off D, not to enter at D itself.

indicators.name: abcd_ratio
indicators.formula: CD_length / AB_length — must be near 1.0 or 1.272 (±tolerance)
indicators.purpose: 1.0x (AB=CD) and 1.272x (Fibonacci extension) are the two most common NIFTY institutional completion ratios. 1.618x is excluded because at 5-second resolution, a 1.618x extension often overshoots and the reversal is too violent/unpredictable for a 120-second hold. Tolerance ±0.08 matches NIFTY's 5-second bar granularity.

indicators.name: bc_retracement
indicators.purpose: Same Fibonacci retracement filter as original (0.382-0.886 of AB). This confirms genuine wave structure: too shallow a BC (<38%) means weak institutional absorption; too deep (>88%) means BC has already unwound most of AB and the pattern is just a continuation, not a reversal setup. No 12x scaling needed — this is a ratio, not a time window.

conditions: Bearish ABCD pattern: A=high_pivot, B=low_pivot, C=high_pivot (C < A), D=low_pivot
CD extension of AB: |D-C|/|A-B| within ±0.08 of 1.0 OR 1.272
AB leg size >= 5 NIFTY spot points (noise filter)
India VIX < 22 (harmonic patterns unreliable in extreme vol regimes)
buy_ce.confirmation: D-pivot confirmed (30 seconds after actual D bar), signal fires immediately at confirmation bar

conditions: Bullish ABCD pattern: A=low_pivot, B=high_pivot, C=low_pivot (C > A), D=high_pivot
CD extension of AB: |D-C|/|A-B| within ±0.08 of 1.0 OR 1.272
AB leg size >= 5 NIFTY spot points (noise filter)
buy_pe.confirmation: D-pivot confirmed (30 seconds after actual D bar)

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points (~10 NIFTY spot points at delta 0.5) — a failed D-point on NIFTY extends 10-20 spot points beyond the pattern's D level before stalling; stop at 5 pts catches these failures early. Pattern invalidity is clear within 30-60 seconds if D does not hold.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points (~16 NIFTY spot points) — the first BC retrace level from D (38.2% of CD) typically covers 15-25 spot points on NIFTY intraday ABCD patterns of 5-30 minute span; targeting 8 pts captures the lower half of this range for a 1:1.6 R:R, consistent with 2-minute hold expectations.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 22 — harmonic patterns become unreliable when market-wide stress disrupts normal institutional wave structure (same threshold as original)
filters.time_filter: 09:25-15:20 IST — skip first 10 min pre-open noise and last 10 min expiry-day spikes
filters.volume_filter: none explicit — NIFTY index volume is pre-aggregated; no meaningful D-bar volume signal at 5-second resolution
filters.trend_filter: none — patterns are contrarian by nature; D-point reversal is explicit anti-trend entry
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices; no bid-ask spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — Fibonacci self-fulfilling prophecy depends on enough participants watching these levels. On NIFTY index (not individual stocks), institutional algo systems are primary participants and many explicitly program Fibonacci re-entry levels. However, if harmonic pattern trading becomes too crowded, patterns will front-run and the reversal will precede D confirmation.

adaptation_notes: Three key adaptations from original: (1) Universe change: original traded NIFTY50 constituent stocks; converted to NIFTY index directly — the pattern thesis requires only OHLCV so no data is lost. (2) Pivot confirmation window: original used 3-bar minimum on 1-min charts (3 minutes); converted to 6-bar minimum on 5-second charts (30 seconds) — NOT a simple 12x scale. We use 30 seconds because we're catching the fast D-point reversal, not waiting for a full 1-min bar; the ABCD pattern itself still spans 5-30 minutes total. (3) Target change: original targeted 38.2% retracement of CD leg expressed as a percentage; converted to 8 fixed option premium points because at 5-second resolution with ATM options (delta 0.5), a 16-spot-point move maps to ~8 option points, which is a realistic 60-second expectation. No CD ratio scaling — ratio is dimensionless and holds at any timeframe. Added minimum AB size filter (5 NIFTY pts) to avoid noise patterns on 5-second bars.
weaknesses: 30-second pivot confirmation lag means entry is 30 seconds after D, which on NIFTY's fast tape can miss 30-50% of the initial snap-back — especially on low VIX days when reversals are swift.
On 5-second bars, NIFTY generates many local highs/lows that satisfy pattern ratios by chance. The 5-point AB minimum and VIX<22 filter reduce but don't eliminate false patterns.
Pattern frequency on NIFTY index is lower than on individual stocks because the index is smoother — expect 2-4 qualifying patterns per day at most, meaning few data points for optimization.
